trott_2024_publisher_recheck.decision: Both captions reuse the same PDF image XObject (xref 89), with identical decoded samples. The current publisher PDF does not resolve the archived Wilde/Wilde II figure duplication. No new dimensions admitted from either figure.

rosburg_2016_hadal.decision: Figure 21 shows repeated PIES/HYCOM snapshots within the observing array, including LC extension and deep eddy pairs. It does not isolate a complete detached Hadal outer boundary. No whole-eddy dimensions or generic population scales admitted.

griidc_daily_adt.checksum_caveat: The dataset download checksum is not assumed to be the individual NetCDF checksum. Cloud acquisition computes the original file SHA256 independently.
griidc_daily_adt.license_metadata: Landing-page JSON-LD declares CC0. Underlying Copernicus attribution and product terms must also be retained when deriving or releasing data.
griidc_daily_adt.next_action: One cloud-only source header and bounded coordinate audit. No ADT values, contour extraction or name join in this audit.

gcoos_2021_metadata_only.scope: A distinct GCOOS subset/version. It has not been established as byte-equivalent to the GRIIDC original, Trott 2024 input, or any other prior analysis.

admission_gates: Pin original file bytes, SHA256, variables, units, coordinates, temporal support, product version and available mean dynamic topography metadata before processing.
Define and validate a contour operator and sensitivity analysis for that product. A 0.17 m contour from another analysis is not automatically transferable.
Keep fixed-level contour, outer closed contour, speed contour, drifter orbit and thermal footprint definitions distinct.
Validate each named case against primary dated position/trajectory evidence; date proximity alone is insufficient. Splits, mergers, reattachments and label ambiguity remain explicit.
Reject open, clipped, land-contaminated or ambiguously joined contours; preserve unresolved cases rather than force a dimension.
Report per-date diagnostic area, equivalent diameter and principal spans with grid/method sensitivity. Sampled date ranges do not establish lifetime or annual envelopes.
No ranking, state containment, seasonal playback, runtime installation or release admission until the relevant evidence and geometry contracts pass.
